target: The SPT canonical congruence primes are exactly 5, 7, and 13.
policy: E1-E11 are explicit premises, not global axioms. E8 and the analytic/model compatibility interfaces include additional unproved application inputs, not verified specializations of cited theorems. The conditional endpoint does not establish those inputs.

inputs.application_scope: The prefactor-free product model is applied only to vector inputs with every Weyl vector zero, established using E6 before applying E5.

inputs.source: J. H. Bruinier and M. Schwagenscheidt, J. Algebra 478 (2017), equation (11)
G. Ligozat, Courbes modulaires de genre 1 (1975), plus standard integral modular-curve theory for X_0(6) away from 6
inputs.analytic_scope: Includes explicit genus-zero descent for actual unitary meromorphic realizations with zero cusp orders, and full point-divisor/cusp compatibility. These remain unproved analytic inputs. Rational-function divisor rigidity is proved internally; see ANALYTIC_BOUNDARY.md.
inputs.citation_status: The precise analytic descent formulation is explained in ANALYTIC_BOUNDARY.md; its generic geometric and rational-coefficient descent steps remain source-facing proof obligations, not a claimed verbatim Ligozat theorem.

inputs.source: No theorem-level source is certified for the exact E8 interfaces. CM, ideal-class, class-field and reduction theory are background motivation only.
inputs.citation_status: The exact oriented level-six, integral CM reciprocity, good-reduction and integral-closure residue formulations are assumed in this conditional development. No claim is made that a cited theorem supplies them. Instantiation requires separate proofs or source-checked derivations.
inputs.scope: Includes negative quadratic order domain and reduced-form equivalences; all four fixed-orientation class equivalences; finite Galois realizations of the actual CM coordinates with integral roots; and compatible reduction models and residue maps. These are not consequences established by this Lean development.
